stages.description: This pack. Locked/safe surface modernization design.
blockers_before_advance: public repo sync verification of this pack

stages.description: Fill placeholder amounts (<<TIER_BASE_*>>, <<TIER_PREMIUM_*>>) with final values; explicit reward table per level per track.
Mongo schema dry-run for bp_reward_claim_ledger + season_state + premium_entitlement; index plan vetted; idempotency proven; no live writes.
Define daily/weekly/season mission contract and XP economy; no live missions yet.
Unlock read-only preview of free track table (no claim, no progress write). BP_LOCKED_V2 stays true.
blockers_before_advance: backend GET /api/battlepass/season + /progress design-only endpoints implemented behind feature flag

stages.description: Enable XP add / progress write for canary internal users only (sfqa@test.com, test@test.com), same pattern as Artifact Stage 8.
Enable POST /api/battlepass/claim for canary internal users only. Verify idempotency and entitlement_delta.
Implement POST /api/battlepass/premium/verify wiring to purchase_ledger from PROJECT_SHOP_IAP_INTEGRATION Track D. DEV-only.
Link premium pass mock product IDs to Apple sandbox + Google license tester; verify end-to-end DEV flow against canary accounts.
stages.rollback: deactivate sandbox products; canary accounts only

stages.description: Flip BP_LOCKED_V2 + BP_PREMIUM_BUY_LOCKED_V2 to false in production. Enable claim, premium buy, public progression.
stages.rollback: emergency BP_LOCKED_V2=true + BP_PREMIUM_BUY_LOCKED_V2=true; pause writes; freeze season
